presets.name: Open World RPG
presets.prompt: Create a full open-world 3D RPG from scratch: terrain with hills and biomes, road network between towns, playable hero character with stats, NPCs, inventory and quest systems, third-person camera, and multiplayer-ready WebSocket foundation. Generate all game files under games/open-world-rpg.

presets.name: Multiplayer FPS Arena
presets.prompt: Create a multiplayer FPS arena from scratch: flat combat map with cover, two team spawn points, weapon and health gameplay, real-time multiplayer via WebSocket server, and browser Three.js client. Full project in games/fps-arena.

presets.name: 3D Racing Game
presets.prompt: Create a 3D racing game: procedural track as road spline on terrain, car controller with physics feel, lap timing, checkpoints, and textured ground. Project in games/racing-track.

presets.name: Sandbox Creative
presets.prompt: Create a Minecraft-style sandbox: editable voxel terrain, place/remove blocks, multiplayer sync, character controller, day-night cycle. games/sandbox-world.

quick_prompts: Create a 3D game from scratch with hero, enemies, terrain, and quests
Add a multiplayer server and sync player positions
Generate a 256x256 terrain with forests, roads, and a spawn town
Create 3D character models and textures for the party
Build an FPS map with cover and team spawns
